items.title: Make the pincode optional before cart
items.body: Accept the pincode via URL or API, default to a metro pincode, and show the delivery promise inline instead of a blocking modal.
items.why_it_helps: 92% of the failures are a 409 on add-to-cart. Agents cannot operate a modal they were never told about.
items.how_to_verify: Delivery check → Added to cart step conversion for agents should rise, and B05 should drop out of the blocker list.
items.verify_metric: Step conversion S4 → S5 for agents

items.title: Normalise phone numbers and relax validation
items.body: Accept +91, 91, 0 and bare 10-digit variants, normalise server-side and return a human-readable error.
items.why_it_helps: Agents type numbers in the format the shopper gave them and rarely retry with a different one.
items.how_to_verify: POST /api/checkout 422 PHONE_FORMAT responses should fall and S6 → S7 step conversion should rise.

items.title: Allow guest cart, defer login to checkout
items.body: Let anonymous sessions create carts and ask for login (or guest checkout) only at payment.
items.why_it_helps: An SMS OTP goes to the shopper's phone, so an agent cannot complete it.
items.how_to_verify: 401 responses on POST /api/cart should disappear and add-to-cart step conversion should rise.
items.verify_metric: Step conversion S4 → S5 for agents

items.title: Provide an HTML size table
items.body: Replace the size chart image with an HTML table (and keep the image as a visual aid).
items.why_it_helps: Agents rely on text. An image-only chart hides the information they need to choose a size.
items.how_to_verify: Step conversion S3 → S4 should rise and size guide requests should stop ending sessions.
items.verify_metric: Variant selected → delivery check step conversion

items.title: Delay or remove the interstitial and keep a close button
items.body: Never block content with an overlay; show the app banner inline and give it an accessible close control.
items.why_it_helps: Agents interpret the overlay as the page content and cannot dismiss it reliably.
items.how_to_verify: Step conversion S1 → S2 for browsing agents should rise.

items.title: Server-render price and stock, and include them in JSON-LD
items.body: Render price, currency and availability in the initial HTML and add a complete schema.org Offer to each product page.
items.why_it_helps: Fetch-based agents never run your JavaScript, so anything rendered client-side is invisible to them.
items.how_to_verify: Step conversion S2 → S3 for user_fetcher sessions should rise.

items.title: Suggest in-stock alternatives
items.body: Expose availability per variant in HTML and JSON-LD and link to the nearest in-stock size or colour.
items.why_it_helps: A dead end gives an agent no next action, so it reports failure to the shopper.
items.how_to_verify: Sessions ending on a 409 variant response should fall.

items.title: Offer an agent-compatible payment option
items.body: Add card tokens or a prepaid payment link and skip the COD OTP for verified agents.
items.why_it_helps: The shopper's phone receives the OTP and the UPI app opens on a device the agent does not control.
items.how_to_verify: Step conversion S7 → S8 should rise for agents.
items.verify_metric: Checkout submitted → order placed step conversion

items.title: Add complete schema.org Product markup
items.body: Emit Product, Offer and ItemAvailability for every variant in JSON-LD.
items.why_it_helps: Structured data is the cheapest reliable way for agents to read product facts.
items.how_to_verify: The JSON-LD site check should pass on all sampled PDPs.

items.title: Higher limits for verified agents, add Retry-After
items.body: Raise the per-IP limit for Verified agents and always return a Retry-After header.
items.why_it_helps: Agents act in bursts from shared IPs and treat a 429 as a hard stop.
items.how_to_verify: 429 responses to Verified agents should fall to near zero.

items.title: Show the same price everywhere
items.body: Fix pricing consistency between product page, cart and checkout.
items.why_it_helps: Agents verify the price against the one they were asked to stay under.
items.how_to_verify: Mismatch rate between PDP and cart should be zero.

items.title: Allow-list verified agents, challenge only suspicious traffic
items.body: Add Web Bot Auth verified operators to the WAF allow-list and switch Declared agents to a risk-based challenge instead of a hard block.
items.why_it_helps: Agents cannot solve interactive challenges, so every block ends the journey immediately.
items.how_to_verify: 403/503 responses to Verified and Declared agents should fall to near zero.

items.title: Fix links and redirect old URLs
items.body: Add 301 redirects for retired product URLs and fix broken internal links.
items.why_it_helps: Agents cannot recover from a 404 the way a human would by searching again.

items.title: Cache listing and product pages
items.body: Serve cached HTML for listing and product pages and investigate the slow endpoints.
items.why_it_helps: Agents run on a tight time budget and abandon slow pages.
items.how_to_verify: p95 should fall below the 5 s threshold.
items.verify_metric: p95 response time for agent sessions

items.title: Review the robots policy for user-triggered agents
items.body: Allow user-triggered fetchers that act for a shopper while keeping training crawlers blocked if desired.
items.why_it_helps: A user-triggered agent honouring robots.txt cannot complete a purchase the shopper asked for.
items.how_to_verify: The robots site check should pass for user-triggered agents.
